purpose: Test whether frozen V3 chip cost structures explain future market reactions beyond matched non-chip and price-only levels; no strategy outcome is an input.

chronology.decision_snapshots: frozen opening/month-end checkpoints; the checkpoint state is fixed before any future test window

eligibility.market_reaction_session_rule: bar_valid and trade_status=1 with positive OHLC; current_day_data_tradable is an execution/composite-data gate and is reported but is not redefined or required for this non-execution market-reaction outcome
eligibility.checkpoint_market_observation_required: exclude a frozen checkpoint from level classification when its exact-date registered bar is invalid or suspended; never carry or synthesize a definition price
eligibility.corporate_action_rule: transform each frozen band on each future effective date by (level-cash_per_share)/share_multiplier; exclude invalid or blocking action paths

level_events.support: a pre-existing tracked band lies below the checkpoint close; first future range overlap is approached from a prior close above the transformed upper edge
level_events.resistance: a pre-existing tracked band lies above the checkpoint close; first future range overlap is approached from a prior close below the transformed lower edge
level_events.event_independence: one deterministic level_id is the independent event; repeated touch rows remain clustered by level_id

placebo.method: same symbol and checkpoint, same side and band relative width; choose the lowest modeled-mass candidate from fixed log-distance multipliers that does not overlap a tracked peak
placebo.paired_reaction_comparison: retain pairs for which both real and placebo levels are touched within the fixed search window
placebo.price_only_benchmark: the pre-checkpoint 20-session swing low for support or swing high for resistance, given the real band's relative width

state_matching.old_base: for each damaged/lost first-revisit event, same-symbol/seller/split intact controls are ranked deterministically by L1 distance using level distance/5%, recent volatility/2%, recent trend/10%, and calendar separation/120 days
state_matching.ambiguity: for each ambiguous checkpoint, same-symbol/split non-ambiguous controls are ranked deterministically by L1 distance using recent volatility/2%, recent trend/10%, and calendar separation/120 days
state_matching.reuse_and_uncertainty: nearest controls may repeat when no equally close alternative exists; all paired uncertainty and gate N remain clustered by symbol

distribution.strength_bins: discovery-period quintile cut points, frozen for validation and holdout

shape_rules.SINGLE_DOMINANT: one tracked mode or largest tracked mode has at least 60% of tracked-mode mass
shape_rules.DOUBLE_PEAK: exactly two tracked modes, or second/largest tracked-mode mass ratio is at least 0.50
shape_rules.BROAD: p90-p10 log width is at or above the discovery 75th percentile and HHI is at or below the discovery 25th percentile
shape_rules.FRAGMENTED_MULTI: at least three modes when no prior rule applies

migration.UPWARD_MIGRATION: corporate-action-adjusted weighted median rises at least 3%
migration.DOWNWARD_MIGRATION: corporate-action-adjusted weighted median falls at least 3%
migration.DISPERSION: absolute median shift is below 3% and p90-p10 width expands at least 25%

corporate_action_sanity.tracker_identity_expected: when the same track survives the action, its prior level is first transformed by the authoritative coordinate rule; ordinary same-day trading may then move the observed level
corporate_action_sanity.exact_daily_full_distribution_comparison: UNAVAILABLE_WITHOUT_REPLAY; do not invent or rebuild it

statistics.cluster_unit: level_id for level reactions and symbol for checkpoint-state outcomes

support: lower material-break probability and future downside excursion
higher local volume/turnover than matched non-chip levels
resistance: lower first-touch crossing probability and slower crossing
higher local volume/turnover than matched non-chip levels
qualitative_predictions.strength: mass, prominence, age, and persistence should show directionally coherent discovery-frozen dose response
qualitative_predictions.repeated_touch: reaction should weaken and crossing should become easier after repeated interaction
qualitative_predictions.migration: upward/downward migration, stable bases, and dispersion should map to distinguishable future structure
qualitative_predictions.old_base_destruction: damaged/lost bases should provide less later support than intact bases
qualitative_predictions.new_base_formation: persistent new bases should provide more later support than transient new bases and placebos
qualitative_predictions.full_distribution: full-shape descriptors may explain reactions not retained by one canonical peak
qualitative_predictions.ambiguity: seller-model disagreement may map to volatility, chop, or structural transition but has no preregistered directional return sign

gate_rules.yes: both out-of-sample periods meet minimum N and are directionally supportive on a majority of the preregistered primary outcomes, with no major opposite result
gate_rules.no: adequately powered out-of-sample periods show no supportive primary outcome or a coherent opposite result
gate_rules.mixed: effects differ by period, seller model, representation, or outcome, or power is insufficient
gate_rules.production_semantics: always NO in this research-only study
gate_rules.full_market_expansion: always NO in this research-only study
